provenance: Was 63 lines weighted toward current makers and Chinese factories; grew it with real historical marques - British interwar makes, Italian and German firms, Czech, Polish, Hungarian and Soviet plants, pre-war Japanese and American makers, French and Spanish marques, and modern electric brands. Every addition is a marque I believe actually existed; none are invented. Confidence high, not checked against a source.
